borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Installation of new Crittall-style doors to the kitchen and living room at ground floor to the rear; New sash window to ground floor guest cloakroom; Construction of new brick lift shaft at ground, first and second floors to the front and side elevation; Relocation of front door with new projecting canopy over at ground floor level to the front garden; Alterations to the existing rear roof extension dormer at second floor to include increase in height and incorporating new French doors with flanking sash windows, painted mild steel balconette railing and new rooflight in flat roof; Introduction of 3no. new sash windows in the side flank wall at first, second and third floor level; Modifications to the hardstanding outside kitchen doors at ground floor level and installation of a frameless glass balustrade.
